source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 5 exercise solved (PDF 113-116): MCQs with keys and reasons, model answers for short and descriptive questions, numericals step by step, Kitab ki ghalti and Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 5 (States and Phases of Matter) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah di gayi hai (kitab MCQs ki answer key nahi deti); short aur descriptive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) aur dono numericals ka qadam ba qadam hal diya gaya hai. Jahan zaroorat hai, "Wazahat" box mein aasan alfaaz mein samjhaya gaya hai.
Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)
Q.1 Har sawal ke chaar jawab diye gaye hain. Sahi jawab chunein.

blocks.prompt:
I. London dispersion forces are the only forces present among:
(London dispersion forces kin ke darmiyan akeli forces hoti hain?)

options.text: Liquid halat mein paani ke molecules
Zyada temperature par gas halat mein helium ke atoms

blocks.explanation: I₂ non-polar molecule hai, is liye solid iodine mein sirf London dispersion (id-id) forces hain; I₂ bara molecule hai is liye yeh forces taqatwar hain (iodine solid hai, b.p. 458 K). Paani mein hydrogen bonds aur HCl mein dipole-dipole forces bhi hain. Zyada temperature par gas mein forces na hone ke barabar hoti hain (gas ideal jaisi, 5.1).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Asal mein helium ke atoms (b) mein bhi sirf London dispersion forces hoti hain, is liye do options durust hain. Murad jawab (c) hai: garam helium gas mein forces na hone ke barabar hain, jab ke solid iodine ko sirf London forces hi jore rakhti hain.

blocks.prompt:
II. When the vapour pressure of a liquid equals the external pressure, what phenomenon occurs?
(Jab liquid ka vapour pressure bahar ke pressure ke barabar ho jaye to kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jis temperature par liquid ka vapour pressure bahar ke (atmospheric) pressure ke barabar ho jaye, us par liquid ubalne lagta hai (5.9).

blocks.prompt:
III. When water freezes at 0 °C, its density decreases due to:
(0 °C par paani jamne se us ki density kyun kam ho jati hai?)

options.text: Barf ke structure mein khaali jaghein

blocks.explanation: Barf mein hydrogen bonds se jure paani ke molecules aik baqaida khuli tetrahedral tarteeb banate hain jis mein khaali jaghein hoti hain; is liye barf taqreeban 9% zyada jagah gherti hai aur density kam ho jati hai (5.4.4).

blocks.prompt:
IV. Which of the following options is wrong about hydrides of groups 14, 15, 16, and 17 elements?
(Groups 14, 15, 16 aur 17 ke hydrides ke bare mein kaunsa option ghalat hai?)

options.text: Sirf H₂O, NH₃ aur HF H-bonding dikhate hain.
Room temperature par H₂S gas hai magar H₂O liquid hai.

blocks.explanation: Hydrogen bond ke liye H ka bohat electronegative atom (F, O ya N) se jura hona aur us atom par lone pair hona zaroori hai (5.4.3). CH₄, H₂S, HCl wagheira mein yeh shart poori nahi hoti, is liye 'tamam hydrides H-bonding dikhate hain' ghalat hai.

blocks.prompt:
V. Which of following is the correct sequence of increasing ∆Hv values of substances mentioned?
(Diye gaye substances ki ∆Hv (molar heat of vaporization) ki barhti hui tarteeb kaunsi durust hai?)
blocks.explanation: ∆Hv intermolecular forces ki taqat par munhasir hai (5.10): H₂O mein sab se zyada hydrogen bonding (40.6 kJ mol⁻¹), NH₃ mein kamzor hydrogen bonding (chapter mein 21.7 kJ mol⁻¹) aur F₂ mein sirf kamzor London forces. Is liye H₂O > NH₃ > F₂, yani barhti tarteeb F₂ < NH₃ < H₂O.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal barhti hui (increasing) tarteeb poochta hai magar har option '>' (ghatti tarteeb) mein likha hai. Sirf (a) H₂O > NH₃ > F₂ durust hai; barhti tarteeb mein yahi F₂ < NH₃ < H₂O hai.

blocks.prompt:
VI. Surface tension of a liquid is due to:
(Liquid ka surface tension kis wajah se hota hai?)

options.text: Satah ke molecules par andar ki taraf khinchao
Satah se oopar ki taraf khinchao

blocks.explanation: Satah wale molecules ko neeche ke molecules andar ki taraf kheenchte hain (intermolecular forces), is liye satah khinchi hui jhilli (skin) ki tarah kaam karti hai (5.5).

blocks.prompt:
VII. Amorphous solids:
(Amorphous solids:)

options.text: ka melting point tez (sharp) hota hai
chaqu se kaatne par saaf cleavage dete hain
mein atoms ki mukammal tarteeb hoti hai
ki koi muqarrar geometric shakal nahi hoti

blocks.explanation: Amorphous solids (glass, plastic sulphur, charcoal) ki koi baqaida teen-dimensional geometric shakal nahi hoti, na long-range order; yeh temperature ki aik range par pighalte hain (5.12.2).

blocks.prompt:
VIII. Which change of state involves overcoming only London dispersion forces?
(Kis tabdeeli-e-halat mein sirf London dispersion forces ko torna parta hai?)

options.text: Sodium chloride ka paani mein hal hona

blocks.explanation: I₂ ke molecules non-polar hain, un ke darmiyan sirf London forces hain. Barf aur ethanol mein hydrogen bonds tootte hain; NaCl ke hal hone mein ionic bonds tootte hain.

blocks.prompt:
IX. In which of the following substances are London dispersion forces the only significant intermolecular forces present?
(Kis substance mein sirf London dispersion forces hi qabil-e-zikr intermolecular forces hain?)
blocks.explanation: CH₄ non-polar hai aur us ka H, F, O ya N se jura nahi, is liye sirf London forces hain. NH₃, H₂O aur HF hydrogen bonds banate hain.

blocks.prompt:
X. Which of the following is a characteristic property of crystalline solids?
(Crystalline solids ki khaas khoobi kaunsi hai?)

options.text: Un ke melting points ki range hoti hai.
Un ka muqarrar aur sharp melting point hota hai.
Un mein particles ki baqaida tarteeb nahi hoti.

blocks.explanation: Crystalline solids aik muqarrar temperature par tezi se pighalte hain aur isi se pehchane jate hain (5.12.1). Woh anisotropic hain aur un mein long-range order hai; (a), (b), (d) amorphous solids ki khoobiyan hain.

blocks.prompt:
XI. Which of the following liquids would you expect to have the highest viscosity at a given temperature?
(Aik hi temperature par kis liquid ki viscosity (behne mein rukawat) sab se zyada hogi?)
blocks.explanation: Glycerol ke har molecule mein teen –OH groups hain, is liye bohat zyada hydrogen bonding hoti hai; forces jitni taqatwar, viscosity utni zyada (5.6.1). Diethyl ether mein –OH nahi, us ki viscosity sab se kam hai.

blocks.prompt:
XII. Which type of intermolecular force is present in all types of molecule regardless of their polarity?
(Kaunsi intermolecular force har qisam ke molecule mein hoti hai, chahe woh polar ho ya non-polar?)
blocks.explanation: Har molecule ka electron cloud lamhati (instantaneous) dipole bana sakta hai, is liye London dispersion forces har molecule mein hoti hain; non-polar molecules mein sirf yahi hoti hain (5.4.1).

blocks.prompt:
XIII. Liquid crystals exhibit properties:
(Liquid crystals ki khoobiyan:)

options.text: Na solids jaisi na liquids jaisi.

blocks.explanation: Liquid crystals liquids ki tarah behte hain aur viscosity rakhte hain, magar crystals ki tarah parallel tarteeb aur optical khoobiyan bhi rakhte hain (5.13).

blocks.text: Q.2 Neeche diye gaye mukhtasar sawalon ke jawab dein:

blocks.prompt:
a. Explain, at a molecular level, why evaporation leads to a cooling effect.
(Molecular level par wazeh karein ke evaporation se thandak kyun hoti hai.)
blocks.explanation: Sirf zyada energy wale molecules satah se nikalte hain aur kam energy wale peeche reh jate hain. Is liye baqi liquid ki average kinetic energy, yani temperature, gir jata hai; phir aas paas se heat liquid mein aati hai aur mahol bhi thanda hota hai (5.7).

blocks.prompt:
b. Explain why liquids with stronger intermolecular forces tend to have lower rates of evaporation at a given temperature compared to liquids with weaker intermolecular forces.
(Wazeh karein ke aik hi temperature par taqatwar intermolecular forces wale liquids kamzor forces wale liquids ki nisbat kam tezi se kyun evaporate hote hain.)
blocks.explanation: Evaporate hone ke liye molecule ke paas itni kinetic energy honi chahiye ke woh parosi molecules ki kashish par ghalib aa sake. Forces taqatwar hon to zyada energy chahiye, is liye kam molecules nikal pate hain aur evaporation ki raftar kam hoti hai (maslan paani acetone se ahista evaporate hota hai).

blocks.prompt:
c. One feels sense of cooling under the fan after bath.
(Nahane ke baad pankhe ke neeche thandak mehsoos hoti hai. Wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Nahane ke baad jism par paani ki teh reh jati hai. Pankha vapour ko hata kar evaporation tez karta hai; nikalne wale zyada energy wale paani ke molecules jism se energy le jate hain, is liye jild thandi mehsoos hoti hai (5.7).

blocks.prompt:
d. Dynamic equilibrium is established during evaporation of a liquid in a closed vessel at constant temperature.
(Band bartan mein constant temperature par liquid ke evaporation ke dauran dynamic equilibrium qaim ho jata hai. Wazeh karein.)
blocks.explanation: Band bartan mein vapour ke molecules bahar nahi ja sakte; woh liquid ke oopar jama hote hain aur kuch wapas liquid mein aa jate hain (condensation). Condensation ki raftar barhti hai yahan tak ke evaporation ki raftar ke barabar ho jati hai. Phir dono amal jari rehte hain magar barabar raftar se, is liye vapour pressure constant rehta hai: liquid ⇌ vapour, yahi dynamic equilibrium hai (5.8).

blocks.prompt:
e. The boiling point of water is different at Lahore and Murree hills.
(Lahore aur Murree mein paani ka boiling point mukhtalif kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Liquid tab ubalta hai jab us ka vapour pressure bahar ke pressure ke barabar ho. Lahore neeche (kam unchai) par hai jahan hawa ka pressure taqreeban 760 torr hai, is liye paani taqreeban 100 °C par ubalta hai. Murree unchai par hai jahan pressure taqreeban 700 torr hai, is liye paani taqreeban 98 °C par ubalta hai (5.9.1).

blocks.prompt:
f. Discuss two significant consequences of the lower density of ice compared to liquid water in natural environments.?
(Qudrati mahol mein barf ki paani se kam density ke do aham nataij bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Barf paani par tairti hai, is liye jheelein aur samandar oopar se neeche jamte hain, neeche se nahi.
2. Tairti barf ki teh neeche ke paani ko thandi hawa se bachati (insulate karti) hai, is liye neeche paani liquid rehta hai aur machhliyan aur doosre aabi jaandar jami hui jheelon ke neeche zinda rehte hain (5.4.4).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal ke aakhir mein faltu '.?' chhapa hai ('environments.?'); wahan sirf sawaliya nishan (?) hona chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
g. Why B.P of a liquid increases when the external pressure rises?
(Bahar ka pressure barhne se liquid ka boiling point kyun barh jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Liquid tab ubalta hai jab us ka vapour pressure bahar ke pressure ke barabar ho. Bahar ka pressure zyada ho to vapour pressure ko us tak pohanchane ke liye liquid ko zyada garam karna parta hai, is liye boiling point barh jata hai; maslan 1489 torr par paani 120 °C par ubalta hai, aur pressure cooker mein khana jaldi pakta hai (5.9.1).

blocks.prompt:
h. Mention four items in which liquid crystals are used.
(Chaar cheezon ke naam likhein jin mein liquid crystals istemal hote hain.)
blocks.explanation:
1. TV, computer/laptop screens aur mobile phones ke displays (LCDs).
2. Calculators aur gharriyan.
3. Thermometers aur temperature sensors (maslan circuit board mein kharab joron ko dhoondna).
4. Tibbi tashkhees (diagnosis): tumours ka pata lagana (maslan breast cancer ki ibtidai stage), kyun ke tumour aas paas ke tissue se zyada garam hota hai (5.13.2).

blocks.prompt:
i. How do you differentiate between crystalline solids and amorphous solids?
(Crystalline aur amorphous solids mein farq kaise karenge?)
blocks.explanation: Dono mein particles ki tarteeb ka farq hai, isi liye shakal, pighalne aur simt (direction) wali khoobiyon mein farq hai (Table 5.5).

rows: Koi muqarrar shakal nahi; dhelay ya powder
Temperature ki range par pighalte hain

blocks.prompt:
j. Propanone (CH₃COCH₃), propanol (CH₃CH₂CH₂OH) and butane (CH₃CH₂CH₂CH₃) have very similar relative molecular masses. List them in the expected order of increasing boiling points. Explain your answer.
(Propanone, propanol aur butane ke relative molecular masses taqreeban barabar hain. Inhein barhte hue boiling point ki tarteeb mein likhein aur wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Tarteeb: butane < propanone < propanol.
Butane non-polar hai: sirf kamzor London forces (b.p. taqreeban −0.5 °C).
Propanone polar hai (C=O): London ke saath dipole-dipole forces (b.p. 56 °C).
Propanol mein O–H group hai: hydrogen bonding, sab se taqatwar (b.p. taqreeban 97 °C).
Mass barabar hai to London forces bhi taqreeban barabar; is liye izafi forces tarteeb tay karti hain.

blocks.prompt:
k. Discuss how hydrogen bonding is responsible for the relatively high surface tension of water.
(Paani ke nisbatan zyada surface tension ki zimmedar hydrogen bonding kaise hai?)
blocks.explanation: Paani ka har molecule parosi molecules se hydrogen bonds banata hai. Satah wale molecule ke oopar paani nahi hota, is liye neeche wale molecules ke saath hydrogen bonds use zor se andar kheenchte hain. Yeh taqatwar andar ka khinchao satah ko jhilli ki tarah tana hua bana deta hai; is liye paani ka surface tension (20 °C par 72.75 × 10⁻³ N m⁻¹) ethanol (22.75 × 10⁻³) se kahin zyada hai (5.4.4, 5.5).

blocks.prompt:
l. What type of intermolecular forces will dominate in the following liquids?
(i) NH₃ (ii) Ar (iii) CH₃COCH₃ (iv) CH₃OH
(In liquids mein kis qisam ki intermolecular forces ghalib hongi?)
blocks.explanation:
(i) NH₃: hydrogen bonding (H, N se jura hai aur N par lone pair hai).
(ii) Ar: sirf London dispersion forces (non-polar atoms).
(iii) CH₃COCH₃: dipole-dipole forces (polar C=O; O–H nahi, is liye apne molecules mein hydrogen bonding nahi).
(iv) CH₃OH: hydrogen bonding (O–H group).

blocks.prompt:
m. The boiling points and molar masses of hydrides of some first-row elements are tabulated below:
(Table printed: CH₄, boiling point 109 K, molar mass 16 g mol⁻¹; NH₃, 240 K, 17 g mol⁻¹; H₂O, 373 K, 18 g mol⁻¹.)
Suggest reasons for the difference in their boiling points in terms of the type of molecules involved and the nature of the forces present between them.
(Table: CH₄ 109 K, 16 g mol⁻¹; NH₃ 240 K, 17 g mol⁻¹; H₂O 373 K, 18 g mol⁻¹. Molecules ki qisam aur un ke darmiyan forces ki buniyad par boiling points ke farq ki wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Teenon ke molar masses taqreeban barabar hain, is liye London forces bhi milti julti hain; farq polarity aur hydrogen bonding ki wajah se hai.
CH₄: non-polar molecule, sirf kamzor London forces, is liye sab se kam b.p. (109 K).
NH₃: polar, hydrogen bonding, magar N par sirf aik lone pair, is liye har molecule taqreeban aik hydrogen bond aur kamzor bonds: b.p. 240 K.
H₂O: do H atoms aur do lone pairs, har molecule ausatan do hydrogen bonds; O, N se zyada electronegative hai: sab se taqatwar aur zyada hydrogen bonding, sab se zyada b.p. (373 K).

blocks.prompt:
Q.3. What are London dispersion forces? Give examples, and discuss the factors affecting these forces.
(London dispersion forces kya hain? Misalein dein aur in forces par asar daalne wale awamil (factors) bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Tareef: Instantaneous dipole aur induced dipole ke darmiyan lamhati kashish ko instantaneous dipole-induced dipole (id-id) force ya London dispersion force kehte hain.
Kaise banti hai: electrons harkat mein rehte hain, is liye kisi lamhe atom ya molecule ka electron cloud aik taraf zyada ho jata hai aur aarzi (instantaneous) dipole ban jata hai. Yeh dipole parosi molecule ke electron cloud ko bigaar (polarize) kar us mein dipole paida (induce) karta hai; dono aik doosre ko kheenchte hain. Yeh dipoles bante aur mitte rehte hain.
Non-polar molecules aur atoms mein sirf yahi forces hoti hain, aur yeh har molecule mein maujood hain.
Misalein: noble gases (He, Ne, Ar...), halogens (F₂, Cl₂, Br₂, I₂), hydrocarbons (CH₄, C₂H₆, C₆H₁₄), CCl₄.
Awamil:
1. Molecular mass aur size: bare atoms/molecules mein zyada electrons aur aasani se polarize hone wala cloud, is liye forces taqatwar. Halogens gas (F₂, Cl₂) se liquid (Br₂) aur solid (I₂, b.p. 458 K) ho jate hain; noble gases ke boiling points He (4.22 K) se Xe (165 K) tak barhte hain.
2. Surface area (shakal): lamba molecule parosi molecules ko zyada jaghon se chhoota hai, is liye forces taqatwar. C₂H₆ −88.6 °C par magar C₆H₁₄ 68.7 °C par ubalta hai. Pentane ke isomers (aik hi Mr) mein seedhi zanjeer wale n-pentane ka surface area aur b.p. sab se zyada, 2-methylbutane darmiyan mein, aur gol-matol 2,2-dimethylpropane ka sab se kam.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: 'zyada electrons + lamba molecule = zyada London force = zyada boiling point'. Isi liye petrol (chhote molecules) jaldi urta hai aur wax (lambe molecules) solid hai.

blocks.prompt:
Q.4 Hydrogen bonding is present in H₂O, NH₃, HF, (CH₃)₂CO and CHCl₃ molecules. Sketch structures and discuss briefly.
(H₂O, NH₃, HF, (CH₃)₂CO aur CHCl₃ molecules mein hydrogen bonding hai. Structures banayein aur mukhtasar bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Shart: hydrogen bond tab banta hai jab H kisi bohat electronegative atom (F, O, N) se jura ho, H par δ+ ho, aur yeh parosi molecule ke F, O ya N ke lone pair ki taraf khinche. Ise dotted line (…) se dikhate hain; yeh covalent bond ka taqreeban das wan hissa taqatwar hai.
1. H₂O: mura hua (bent) molecule, do O–H bonds aur O par do lone pairs (Hδ+, Oδ−). Khaka: Oδ−–Hδ+ … :Oδ− (agla molecule). Har molecule ausatan do hydrogen bonds banata hai, teen-dimensional jaal; is liye b.p. zyada (100 °C).
2. NH₃: pyramid shakal, teen N–H bonds aur N par aik lone pair. Khaka: H₂N–H … :NH₃. Sirf aik lone pair, is liye har molecule taqreeban aik hydrogen bond aur kamzor bonding; b.p. −33 °C.
3. HF: H–F, F par teen lone pairs magar H sirf aik. Khaka: H–F … H–F … H–F, zig-zag zanjeer (solid mein). F sab se zyada electronegative hai, is liye bond taqatwar; b.p. 19.9 °C. Do F atoms ke beech H phans jane se HF kamzor acid hai.
4. (CH₃)₂CO (propanone) aur CHCl₃ (chloroform): dono apne jaise molecules se hydrogen bond nahi banate. Propanone mein polar C=O aur O par lone pairs hain magar O–H nahi; chloroform ke C–H ka H teen Cl atoms ki wajah se δ+ hai (apne molecules mein dipole-dipole forces, 5.4.2). Jab dono milaye jayen to CHCl₃ ka H propanone ke O ke lone pair ki taraf khinchta hai: Cl₃C–Hδ+ … :O=C(CH₃)₂ (chapter se bahar).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: (CH₃)₂CO aur CHCl₃ apne hi molecules ke darmiyan hydrogen bonding nahi dikhate: propanone mein O, N ya F se jura H nahi, aur chapter chloroform mein dipole-dipole forces batata hai (5.4.2). Kamzor hydrogen bond sirf tab banta hai jab CHCl₃ aur propanone ko milaya jaye.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Khaka (sketch) banane ka tareeqa: har molecule ke atoms aur bonds seedhi lakeer se, lone pairs do nuqton (:) se, H par δ+ aur O/N/F par δ− likhein, aur aik molecule ke H se doosre molecule ke lone pair tak dotted line (…) khenchein; yahi hydrogen bond hai.

blocks.prompt:
Q.5 Discuss the structural changes when water turns into ice. Justify the empty spaces in its crystals as compared to H₂O at 4 °C and lower density of ice.
(Paani ke barf banne par structure mein kya tabdeeliyan hoti hain? 4 °C ke paani ke muqable mein barf ke crystals mein khaali jaghon aur barf ki kam density ki wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Paani ke molecule mein O ke gird tetrahedral tarteeb hai: do kono par O–H bonds aur do par lone pairs. Is liye har molecule chaar parosiyon se hydrogen bonds bana sakta hai (do apne H se, do apne lone pairs se).
2. Liquid paani mein (4 °C par sab se ghana) hydrogen bonds tootte aur bante rehte hain, molecules harkat karte hain aur be-tarteeb magar kafi qareeb rehte hain.
3. Thanda ho kar jamne par molecules ki kinetic energy kam ho jati hai aur woh apni jagah ruk jate hain. Har O chaar doosre molecules se hydrogen bonds ke zariye tetrahedral shakal mein jura hota hai, aur yeh baqaida tarteeb poore crystal mein phail jati hai: aik khula hexagonal pinjre jaisa jaal.
4. Hydrogen bonds molecules ko muqarrar faasle aur angle par rakhte hain, is liye woh qareeb nahi aa sakte aur jaal mein khaali jaghein reh jati hain.
5. Is liye barf utne hi mass ke paani se taqreeban 9% zyada jagah leti hai, density kam hoti hai aur barf paani par tairti hai.
Nateeja: jheelein oopar se jamti hain; tairti barf neeche ke paani ko bachati hai, is liye aabi jaandar zinda rehte hain (5.4.4).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Misal: jaise aadmi haath pakar kar ghera banayein to beech mein khaali jagah bach jati hai, waise hi barf mein hydrogen bonds molecules ko 'haath pakar' kar khula jaal banate hain; pighalne par yeh ghera toot jata hai aur molecules qareeb aa jate hain.

blocks.prompt:
Q.6 How liquid crystals resemble liquids and solids? Give their uses in daily life.
(Liquid crystals liquids aur solids se kis tarah milte julte hain? Rozmarra zindagi mein in ke istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Liquid crystals: kuch substances khaas temperatures par aisi halat mein hote hain jo na poori liquid na poori solid hai (crystalline solid → dhundla liquid (liquid crystal) → saaf liquid). In ke molecules sakht aur rod jaise hain (lambai qutar ki chaar se aath guna).
Liquids se mushabihat: liquids ki tarah behte hain; liquids jaisi viscosity rakhte hain; molecules fluid mein idhar udhar ja sakte hain.
Solids (crystals) se mushabihat: parallel baqaida tarteeb (lambe axis taqreeban mutawazi, jaise lakriyon ka dher); crystals jaisi optical khoobiyan; kuch had tak sakht; hamesha anisotropic; molecules apne lambe axis par ghoom sakte hain magar ulat palat (end over end) nahi ho sakte.
Rozmarra istemal:
1. LCDs: TV, computer/laptop screens, mobile displays, calculators, gharriyan, oscillographs (bijli se roshni ko control karne wale aalaat).
2. Tashkhees (diagnosis): cholesteric liquid crystals jild par lagane se tumour ka pata chalta hai kyun ke woh aas paas se garam hota hai (breast cancer ki jaldi pehchan).
3. Temperature maloom karna: thermometers, aur circuit board ke kharab jor ko us ki zyada garmi se pehchanna (5.13).

blocks.prompt:
Q.7 Describe the following properties of crystalline solids.
i) Geometrical shape ii) Melting point
iii) Cleavage plan iv) Habit of a crystal
(Crystalline solids ki yeh khoobiyan bayan karein: i) geometrical shakal ii) melting point iii) cleavage plane iv) crystal ki habit.)
blocks.explanation:
i) Geometrical shakal: har crystalline solid ki aik muqarrar aur khaas geometric shakal hoti hai kyun ke us ke atoms, ions ya molecules teen dimensions mein muqarrar tarteeb se hote hain. Aik crystal ke chehron (faces) ke milne ke angles (interfacial angles) hamesha wahi rehte hain, chahe crystal kaise bhi ugaya jaye; bareek powder mein bhi faces aur angles wahi rehte hain.
ii) Melting point: crystalline solids ka melting point sharp aur muqarrar hota hai (tamam bonds aik jaise, aik hi temperature par tootte hain), is liye inhein melting point se pehchana jata hai; amorphous solids range mein pighalte hain.
iii) Cleavage plane: crystalline solid toote to muqarrar satahon (planes) par toot-ta hai jinhein cleavage planes kehte hain. Aik crystal ke liye yeh planes aapas mein khaas angle par hote hain, aur yeh angle har solid ka alag hai.
iv) Crystal ki habit: jis shakal mein crystal aam tor par ugta hai use us ki habit kehte hain. Halaat wahi rahein to shakal wahi rehti hai; halaat badlein to shakal badal sakti hai. Maslan NaCl ke crystals cube shakal ke hain, magar mehlool mein 10% urea (milawat) ho to suee jaise ho jate hain (5.12.1).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Hissa iii) mein 'Cleavage plan' chhapa hai; murad 'cleavage plane' hai.

blocks.prompt:
Q8. A sample of an unknown gas has a mass of 0.560 g. It occupies a volume of 2.87 × 10⁻⁴ m³ at a temperature of 300 K and a pressure of 1.01 × 10⁵ Pa. Calculate the molar mass of the gas. (Gas constant, R = 8.31 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹)
(Aik na-maloom gas ka mass 0.560 g hai. 300 K aur 1.01 × 10⁵ Pa par us ka volume 2.87 × 10⁻⁴ m³ hai. Gas ka molar mass maloom karein. (R = 8.31 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹))
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: m = 0.560 g, V = 2.87 × 10⁻⁴ m³, T = 300 K, P = 1.01 × 10⁵ Pa, R = 8.31 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹
Maloom karna: molar mass M
Formula: PV = (m/M)RT, is liye M = mRT / PV
Qeematein: M = (0.560 g × 8.31 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹ × 300 K) / (1.01 × 10⁵ Pa × 2.87 × 10⁻⁴ m³)
Oopar wala hissa = 1396 g J mol⁻¹
Neeche wala hissa = 28.99 Pa m³ = 28.99 J (1 Pa m³ = 1 J)
M = 1396 / 28.99 g mol⁻¹ = 48.2 g mol⁻¹
Jawab: gas ka molar mass = 48.2 g mol⁻¹

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: SI units mein P (Pa) × V (m³) = joule banta hai, aur R bhi J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹ mein hai; is liye J cancel ho jate hain aur sirf g mol⁻¹ bachta hai. Agar volume dm³ ya cm³ mein ho to pehle m³ mein badlein (1 dm³ = 10⁻³ m³, 1 cm³ = 10⁻⁶ m³).

blocks.prompt:
Q9. In a laboratory experiment, 150 cm³ of a volatile liquid was completely vaporized at 98 °C and a pressure of 1.01 × 10⁵ Pa. The mass of the vapor was found to be 0.495 g. Determine the molecular mass of the liquid (R = 8.314 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹).
(Lab mein aik jaldi urne wale liquid ke 150 cm³ (vapour) 98 °C aur 1.01 × 10⁵ Pa par mukammal vapour bane. Vapour ka mass 0.495 g tha. Liquid ka molecular mass maloom karein (R = 8.314 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹).)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: V = 150 cm³ = 150 × 10⁻⁶ m³ = 1.50 × 10⁻⁴ m³ (vapour ka volume), T = 98 °C + 273 = 371 K, P = 1.01 × 10⁵ Pa, m = 0.495 g, R = 8.314 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹
Maloom karna: Mr
Formula: Mr = mRT / PV
Qeematein: Mr = (0.495 g × 8.314 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹ × 371 K) / (1.01 × 10⁵ Pa × 1.50 × 10⁻⁴ m³)
Oopar wala hissa = 1526.8 g J mol⁻¹
Neeche wala hissa = 15.15 J
Mr = 1526.8 / 15.15 g mol⁻¹ = 100.8 g mol⁻¹
Jawab: liquid ka molecular mass ≈ 101 (molar mass 101 g mol⁻¹)

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Temperature hamesha kelvin mein lein: T(K) = °C + 273. 150 cm³ yahan vapour ka volume hai (liquid ka nahi), kyun ke ideal gas equation sirf gas/vapour par lagti hai.
